markets.title: Kansas City wins
markets.rules_primary: If Kansas City wins the IND Colts vs KC Chiefs Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the team who wins the IND Colts vs KC Chiefs Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026.
